annotations.text: The forge look carried over: quiet console keys with colored function edges, one hot ember key per page, JetBrains Mono for every readout. The masthead's device chips are on every tab and are adjustable (chevron); each chip states in use vs idle for ITS OWN work, so two subsystems sharing a card — like Speech and Tools both on GPU 0 here — stay unambiguous.

Trained voices apply automatically: picking a voice that has a model speaks through it, and the Speak tab says so in plain text (which epoch, what strength). The old on/off toggle is gone — the Train tab owns epoch choice and strength instead.
Capture is one left-to-right flow: bring audio in (files or URL), pick from the voices the scan found, name it and save. Saved voices show up in Speak and Train immediately.
